bump_effect.claim: Charcoal(c) box frame turned dark gray (G) when arrow bumped it from below. Blue center unchanged.

controls.claim: Green/white 4x4 arrow is player. Each arrow press moves it 4px (one logical 4x4 cell) and rotates white tip to face that dir. Boxes solid: bump = no-op move.

goal1_solved.claim: L1 solved by covering all 3 trough cells (7,7),(7,8),(7,9) with the 3 boxes: aim+SPACE attaches box (mirrors arrow moves), aim+SPACE detaches. Blocked press=no-op.

goal_hyp.claim: Blue trough = 3 cells (7,7),(7,8),(7,9) with gray fill; 3 boxes exist. Hypothesis: win = all 3 boxes cover the trough cells.

hud.claim: Bottom row pink bar shrinks 1px/action from 64 (freed cells charcoal). Step/time budget.

l2_budget.claim: Pink bar ~1px/action from 64 => ~64 action budget per attempt. Placing 6 pieces by hand (~15 each) exceeds it.

l2_goal.claim: L2 trough = 6 cells (rows 7,8,9 x cols 3,4). Pieces = 5 boxes + 1 orange block. Win likely = cover all 6 cells.

l2_objects.claim: L2: trough vertical cells (7,3),(8,3),(9,3). Orange 1x1 block moves autonomously every action (patrols/bounces), drags adjacent boxes with it (delivers them near trough). Arrow attach mechanic same as L1.

l2_orange.claim: Orange moves 1 cell every action on its own; any box adjacent to it follows keeping offset (frame turns black B). Passively delivered 3 boxes onto trough cells. Arrow attach on orange untested.

mechanic_attach.claim: Aim at box (adjacent+last-move-direction) then SPACE ATTACHES it (white). Attached box mirrors every arrow move (fixed offset). SPACE while aiming again detaches. Blocked press = full no-op (no in-place rotation).
